label: Gender norms
description: How the world judges the way the commander presents. Squad members react only through their own stance, set at import.

choices.label: Indifferent
choices.description: Nobody cares how the commander presents. Results are what count.
choices.lore: Command is judged on results, not on how the commander looks.

choices.label: Corporate machismo
choices.description: Corporate command culture expects a hard, masculine bearing. A commander who presents otherwise starts with less standing at their own corporation.
choices.lore: Corporations expect a hard, masculine bearing from command.

effects.text: Corporate staff and oversight officers treat a soft or feminine bearing in command as a flaw worth remarking on.

choices.label: Inverted norms
choices.description: Corporate command culture expects a soft, careful bearing. A commander who presents as hard starts with less standing at their own corporation.
choices.lore: Command is expected to present softly; hard bearings draw remarks.

effects.text: Corporate staff and oversight officers treat a hard or masculine bearing in command as a flaw worth remarking on.

label: Off-spec stigma
description: How the wider world treats off-spec soldiers. Squad members may share the contempt or reject it, according to their own profile.

choices.label: Tolerated
choices.description: Off-spec units are a nuisance, not a disgrace. Nothing special happens to them.
choices.lore: Off-spec units are a nuisance, not a disgrace.

choices.label: Scorned
choices.description: Civilians and clerks look down on off-spec units. Missions pay a little less.
choices.lore: Off-spec units are looked down on; pay for them is docked.

effects.text: Civilians and clerks treat off-spec units with open contempt and avoid being seen with them.

choices.label: Hunted
choices.description: Off-spec units are hunted. Purge sweeps reach the districts and the news frightens those who take it to heart.
choices.lore: Off-spec units are hunted; purge sweeps hit the districts.

effects.text: Few outsiders will shelter off-spec units; the sweeps are a daily rumor and a daily fear.

label: Oversight
description: How hard the corporation's oversight office presses the unit: Leash approvals, penalties for failed command missions and the tone of its messages.

choices.label: Lenient
choices.description: Oversight approves Leash requests readily and forgives failures.
choices.lore: Oversight approves Leash requests readily and forgives failure.

effects.text: Corporate messages are polite, slow to blame and quick to approve.

choices.label: Standard
choices.description: Oversight is routine: forms, quotas and a cold stamp.
choices.lore: Oversight is routine: forms, quotas and a cold stamp.

choices.label: Brutal
choices.description: Oversight approves few Leash requests and punishes every failed command mission.
choices.lore: Oversight is harsh: few approvals, and failure is punished.

effects.text: Corporate messages are curt and threatening; every failure is noted.

label: Bloom horror
description: How explicitly mutants, the Bloom and wounds are described. This can be changed during the campaign.

choices.label: Restrained
choices.description: Mutants and wounds are described briefly, without gore.
choices.lore: Mutants and wounds are described with restraint.

effects.text: Describe mutants, the Bloom and wounds briefly and without gore; imply more than you show.

choices.label: Graphic
choices.description: Mutants and wounds are described explicitly and in physical detail.
choices.lore: Mutants and wounds are described in graphic, unflinching detail.

effects.text: Describe mutants, the Bloom and wounds explicitly and in unflinching physical detail.

label: Tone
description: How often the story offers small wins, rescues and good news against losses. It steers the story director, not the numbers.

choices.label: Grim hope
choices.description: Small wins, rescues and good news come often enough to matter.
choices.lore: Small wins, rescues and good news come often enough to matter.

effects.text: Offer small wins, rescues and good news regularly alongside the losses.

choices.label: Grim
choices.description: Wins and losses come in rough balance.
choices.lore: Wins and losses come in rough balance.

effects.text: Balance small wins and good news against losses; neither should dominate.

choices.label: Bleak
choices.description: Good news is rare and most outcomes cost something.
choices.lore: Good news is rare; most outcomes cost something.

effects.text: Good news and rescues are rare. Favour losses, shortages and hard trade-offs.

label: Disposition of the squad
description: How the defective soldiers meet the commander and how they react to treatment. It changes how fast trust is won and lost, not how strong anyone is.

choices.label: Kind
choices.description: Off-spec soldiers are kind at heart, quirks aside. Trust comes easily and breaks slowly.
choices.lore: Off-spec soldiers are kind at heart, quirks aside.

choices.label: Guarded
choices.description: Off-spec soldiers are wary. Trust is earned at a fair price.
choices.lore: Off-spec soldiers are wary; trust is earned.

choices.label: Prickly
choices.description: Off-spec soldiers are prickly and slow to forgive. Losses weigh more than gains.
choices.lore: Off-spec soldiers are prickly and slow to forgive.

choices.label: Volatile
choices.description: Off-spec soldiers are volatile. Slights are remembered and mutiny is possible earlier.
choices.lore: Off-spec soldiers are volatile; slights are remembered.

choices.label: Hazardous
choices.description: Off-spec soldiers are hazardous assets who bite when cornered. Trust is rare and worth a great deal.
choices.lore: Off-spec soldiers are hazardous assets who bite when cornered.
